title: What Is Anaphora? — A Literary Guide for English Students and Teachers
skills: define anaphora as a literary and rhetorical device
identify repetition at the beginnings of successive clauses or lines

alignment_note: Explains anaphora as deliberate repetition at the beginnings of successive clauses, sentences, or poetic lines. Supports rhetorical analysis, poetry analysis, persuasive writing, rhythm, emphasis, and interpretation of author's craft across high school English courses.
